All digital books in one app!
Biblio makes it easy to read and listen to your library's literature wherever you are.

Biblio is the library app where you can borrow, read and listen to your favorite literature, both streamed and off-line. Explore among top lists, categories or search your favorites. 

Off-line
If you want to save surf or have a bad cell coverage, you can download the books you want to read or listen to. The books are then stored on your device and you can listen to them on the train or on the flight without interruption.

Biblio, the extension of your library.
Biblio makes it possible to access your library's book catalog. If you do not find the book that you would like to read or listen to, please contact your library and they will help you find what you are looking for.

There may be limits as to how many books you can borrow. If you have questions about how many books you can borrow, please contact your library and they will inform you about which rules they have. 

Logins are managed by your library. If you have problems logging in, please contact your library.

Most libraries are connected to Biblio (Sweden, Finland) some may be a part of a portal and that name will show in the login list. If you do not find the library you are looking for, please contact your library.

App rights.
Biblio asks for rights to your phone function. The app uses this right to pause playback of a book when you receive a phone call.
